official_definition: While a seemingly simple effect, Twinkle Advent is the basis for many OTKs, together with cards such as Omnimon and The CreationDragonDeity Grand-Siegfried.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Awaken] or [Twinkle Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Awaken]", "give [Twinkle Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
